text: What kind of shopping does the writer enjoy, do you think?
zh: 你觉得作者喜欢哪种购物？
zh_hant: 你覺得作者喜歡哪種購物？

text: 'You needn't be so rude about it,'
my wife answered as she looked at herself in the mirror.
I sat down on one of those modern chairs with holes in it and waited.
zh: 我在一把带孔洞的现代椅子上坐下，等着。
zh_hant: 我在一把帶孔洞的現代椅子上坐下，等著。

text: We had been in the hat shop for half an hour
zh: 我们在帽子店已经待了半小时了，
zh_hant: 我們在帽子店已經待了半小時了，

text: and my wife was still in front of the mirror.
zh: 而妻子还站在镜子前面。
zh_hant: 而妻子還站在鏡子前面。

text: 'We mustn't buy things we don't need,' I remarked suddenly.
zh: “我们不该买不需要的东西，”我突然说道。
zh_hant: “我們不該買不需要的東西，”我突然說道。

text: I regretted saying it almost at once.
zh: 我几乎立刻后悔说了这话。
zh_hant: 我幾乎立刻後悔說了這話。

text: 'You needn't have said that,' my wife answered.
'I needn't remind you of that terrible tie you bought yesterday.'
zh: “我也不用提醒你昨天买的那条可怕的领带。”
zh_hant: “我也不用提醒你昨天買的那條可怕的領帶。”

text: 'A man can never have too many ties.'
'And a woman can't have too many hats,' she answered.
zh: “女人帽子再多也不嫌多，”她回答。
zh_hant: “女人帽子再多也不嫌多，”她回答。

text: Ten minutes later we walked out of the shop together.
zh: 十分钟后，我们一起走出了商店。
zh_hant: 十分鐘後，我們一起走出了商店。

text: My wife was wearing a hat that looked like a lighthouse!
zh: 妻子戴着一顶像灯塔一样的帽子！
zh_hant: 妻子戴著一頂像燈塔一樣的帽子！
